target_customer: Nigerian and pan-African small and medium businesses that accept payments and need business banking
problem: Businesses in Nigeria struggled to pay bills, accept payments and bank digitally. Kudi started as a chat-based payments assistant and grew into POS, checkout and business banking.
business_model: Payments take rate on POS and online transactions plus business banking, overdraft and treasury products

founders.name: Yinka Adewale
founders.background_notes: Listed as Founder/CEO on the YC page. Background not found in a source I opened.

founders.name: Pelumi Aboluwarin
founders.background_notes: Listed as Founder/CTO on the YC page and as co-founder in TechCrunch, Feb 2017.

competitors.name: Paga
competitors.what: Nigerian payments startup combining online and offline payments

competitors.name: KongaPay
competitors.what: Mobile app for paying bills and buying products online and in person

technical_complexity.rationale: A chatbot on Messenger with bill-payment integrations was standard engineering in 2017. Later switching, POS and licensed banking raised the difficulty.

defensibility.rationale: The 2017 chatbot was easy to copy. Defensibility grew later through licensed banking via Nombank MFB and merchant integrations.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents were already serving Nigerian bill payment in 2017; none is reported to have acquired Kudi, which pivoted to POS and business banking.

market_need_then: In Feb 2017 TechCrunch reported Kudi targeted users with limited internet access, was part of Facebook Free Basics, and had processed about $15,000 in transactions with revenue growing 125 percent week over week.

branding.name_origin: Nomba is a play on the word number, per a company VP quoted in April 2022 coverage of the rebrand. Kudi was the earlier name.

identity.logo: Redesigned visual system in 2022 by an agency, described only as a brand, product, digital and print refresh

rebrands.why: Reported to avoid confusion with Nigerian digital bank Kuda and to reflect a broader omnichannel payments platform

branding.community_and_virality: Widespread Nigerian tech press coverage of the 2022 rebrand and the 2023 raise. No evidence of merch or fan community.

brand_strength.rationale: The original name Kudi was confusable with Kuda and was replaced in 2022. Nomba has press recognition but no sourced evidence of brand-led growth.

pivots.from: Kudi chat-based payments assistant on messaging apps
pivots.to: Omnichannel business payments and banking platform as Nomba
pivots.why: Reported move into an omnichannel payments platform for businesses

outcome_analysis: Kudi began as a Messenger payments chatbot in 2017 and later became Nomba, a business payments and banking platform. It raised a reported $5M early round and a $30M round in May 2023 and says it serves hundreds of thousands of businesses. The pivot from consumer chat to merchant payments and licensed banking is what turned it into a scaled company.
notes: The 2023 round is labelled pre-Series B by Nairametrics and other outlets; PitchBook calls it Series B. The earlier $5M round has no date or investors in the cited article. Valuation of about $150M and total raised ($43M or $58.5M) come from aggregators and are unverified. Searches for the earlier name Paypad found nothing connecting it to this company. The Canadian payments acquisition by Nomba (completed 2025) was reported by launchbaseafrica and others but not opened.
